messages:
Nadia Park: ticket #4021: customer says they were billed for both a partial stream and the resumed stream after a retry; no toolcalls.
Owen Li: can you paste the router trace? looks like possible cross-zone retry.
Nadia Park: trace: initial stream -> zone-west, EOF at chunk 2; client retried and CDN routed to zone-east. both zones logged provisional grants.
Ravi Shah: current behavior: each route issues provisional credits; we finalize on segment.confirm. without a client session id across retry, we end up with two provisional rows.
Ben (billing): finance: we can't auto-merge unless high confidence. customers see two rows and assume double charge. we need better visibility first.
Liz (console): short-term: add a "provisional" badge + route_id column and link to raw telemetry for each ledger row. quick UX fix that helps support triage. ETA 48h for a first pass.
Owen Li: telemetry: emit stream.session.client_id when present and include route_id and segment_id on provisional events. that'll allow offline reconciliation.
Ravi Shah: propose recommending X-Client-Session header in SDKs for streaming. make optional but emphasized in docs. server-generated ids won't survive CDN-based retries.
Ben (billing): for refunds: if client_session_id present, group provisional credits by session and auto-collapse within 90s window. otherwise surface "possible duplicate" in the UI; require manual review. never auto-merge entries with toolcall.invoked=true.
Nadia Park: customer used a custom client so no session header. ops: should we offer manual refund trajectory?
Ben (billing): yes, escalate to billing ops with the trace + telemetry links. we'll review with legal if necessary.
Liz (console): I'll add a filter "possible retry duplicate" using these heuristics and surface telemetry links for support.
Ravi Shah: longer-term RFC: billing pipeline to run a conservative reconciliation pass with audit logs. heuristics: prefer client_session_id match; fallback to high-entropy fingerprint (customer_id + prompt_prefix(32) + first_confirmed_token + 45s window). mark non-high-confidence merges as "audit_suggested" rather than auto-apply.
Owen Li: router change: attach route_id to provisional-charge telemetry. small change.
ops-bot: task created: ledger-provisional-badge PR queued for review.
Nadia Park: I'll update the ticket with interim explanation and link to this thread. leaving open until console patch + RFC land.
